The website I run just crossed 1,000 members! 🎉

In the last week alone, it served 2.65 million requests. It's the small, independent transformative works archive I run on a four-core home server and built on the open-source codebase powering Archive of Our Own. 

I've learned quite a bit about production ops in the process.

If fandom, fanworks, or the indie web are your thing? come check it out: https://fanfiction.lol

#indieweb #selfhosted #fandom #opensource
